title: EAP based Identification initiation by the network
text: If the AUSF or the AAA server of the CH or the DCS decides to initiate the EAP based identification procedure, the AUSF or the AAA server of the CH or the DCS shall send an EAP-Request/Identity or EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity message as specified in IETFRFC5448[40]
The AMF shall encapsulate the EAP-Request/Identity or EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity message in the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message and send it to the UE
